articles.title: Sain's 29-point effort lifts Maine over VCU in overtime, 85-80
articles.summary: ORONO, Maine — Kaliyah Sain scored a career-high 29 points, including 15 in overtime, to lead the Maine women's basketball team past VCU, 85-80, Thursday evening at Memorial Gymnasium. The Black Bears improved to 4-1 with the win.

articles.title: PREVIEW: Swim & Dive heads to four-day Harold Anderson Invitational
articles.summary: ORONO, Maine -- The University of Maine swim & dive team will begin competition in the 30th Harold Anderson Invitational on Thursday evening at 5 p.m. The four-day meet is hosted by the University of Rhode Island at the Tootell Aquatic Center.

articles.title: Women's Basketball announces signing of Hannah Fraser
articles.summary: ORONO, Maine -- University of Maine women's basketball head coach has announced the signing of Hannah Fraser. Fraser, a 6-2 forward, will be eligible to join the Black Bears in the fall of 2027.

articles.title: Fitzpatrick collects second America East Player of the Week accolade
articles.summary: ORONO, Maine -- For the second consecutive week, Maddie Fitzpatrick has been named the America East Player of the Week as announced by the league on Monday morning.

articles.title: Fitzpatrick's double-double lifts Maine over Brown, 53-48
articles.summary: ORONO, Maine — Maddie Fitzpatrick posted a career-high 20 points and 11 rebounds as the University of Maine women's basketball team defeated Brown, 53-48, Sunday afternoon at Skip Chappelle Court. The Black Bears improved to 3-1 with the win.

articles.title: PREVIEW: Women's Basketball welcomes Brown on Military Appreciation Day
articles.summary: ORONO, Maine -- The University of Maine women's basketball team hosts Brown on Military Appreciation Day, presented by General Dynamics Bath Iron Works this Sunday, Nov. 15, at 1 p.m. Limited tickets for this game are available by visiting GoBlackBears.com/Ticket.

articles.title: Women's Basketball pushes Oregon before falling, 79-72
articles.summary: ORONO, Maine — The University of Maine women's basketball team led Big Ten opponent Oregon for much of Friday night's game at Memorial Gymnasium, but the Ducks pulled away in the fourth quarter for a 79–72 win in front of a sold out crowd of 1,507.

articles.title: PREVIEW: Women's Basketball to host Oregon, Red Panda
articles.summary: ORONO, Maine -- The University of Maine women's basketball team looks for its first 3-0 start since 2020 when they take on Big Ten opponent Oregon in the first-ever meeting between the two programs on Friday evening at 7 p.m. Limited tickets for this game are available by visiting GoBlackBears.com/Tickets.

articles.title: Women's Basketball to host annual Military Appreciation Day, Nov. 15
articles.summary: ORONO, Maine -- The University of Maine athletics department is proud to once again bring to our service men and women its Military Appreciation Series, presented by General Dynamics Bath Iron Works. The series, in its 11th year, provides the opportunity for the Black Bears to honor our military men and women at select athletic events over the course of the 2026-27 season.
